cue: A claim's check has several parts, and one run is called the claim's verification.
lesson: Record each part of a check as its own event with the run that proves it; a claim is verified only when every part has one.
evidence: aip-6fb1 c2 was recorded as verified on run 41295117407, but that run smoked amd64 only and never tried the no-rebuild path; the checkpoint critic found both (c2-review round 1, two Majors), and round 2 found the fixes themselves still had no run on record (two more Majors).
